tagline: Jev is the paddle — a rally that speeds up and outruns it

examples.prompt: Set Jev Pong up as a tense rally — a mid-size court at speed 6 with a gentle accel so the ball builds up over a few returns. Give Jev a decisive style line, then watch it hold the streak until the rally outruns the paddle.
examples.caption: Jev's Rally — a fast decision model chasing a ball that speeds up with every return
